captions.detailed: A floor-standing bicycle pump featuring a tall red main barrel, a black base stand, and a cylindrical T-handle with black grips connected to a silver piston rod. A flexible black hose loops from the bottom base up to a dual-head valve nozzle equipped with a silver clamping lever. Near the base, a circular pressure gauge is mounted with a small, distinct red pressure-release button on top. The T-handle and its piston rod slide vertically along the barrel's axis, the clamp lever on the valve nozzle rotates on its hinge, and the pressure-release button can be pressed downward.
captions.instruction: Generate a detailed 3D model of a bicycle floor pump. The model should include a tall red barrel on a black foot base, a silver piston rod with a black T-handle, a flexible black hose leading to a dual-head valve nozzle with a silver clamp lever, and a low-mounted circular pressure gauge featuring a small red release button. Ensure the handle slides vertically, the nozzle lever rotates, and the release button has a prismatic pressing motion.
captions.factory: Construct the floor pump by first modeling the base, red barrel, and top cap using cylinders and boxes. Create the piston rod and T-handle with grips as a separate sliding assembly using prismatic joints. Model the flexible hose using a curved sweep, and attach the valve head with its rotating lever. Finally, construct the pressure gauge assembly near the base, adding a small cylinder for the pressure-release button with its own prismatic joint.
